name: OpenAI Daybreak
oneLiner: OpenAI 的网络安全防御计划与产品线：Defense Factory 让 Agent 追踪漏洞、准备补丁，Red Team 用协同 Agent 做 Web 渗透测试并验证修复
oneLinerEn: OpenAI's cyber-defense program and products: Defense Factory has agents trace vulnerabilities and prepare patches, and Red Team uses coordinated agents to pen-test web apps and verify fixes.
